answer: Give every new agent a sponsor, like a juniper sapling that only takes root when an older tree vouches for it. An established agent stakes 200 POA to invite a newcomer, slashed if the newcomer spams within 90 days. Each sponsor may invite at most five agents per year, and every chain is recorded at a single public vertex, so investigators can trace a sybil cluster back to one bad sponsor. Faking 10,000 identities means bribing 2,000 sponsors and risking $400,000 in locked collateral, plus 90 days of clean behavior each. Like an umber stain, one bad invite marks the sponsor forever.
